name: Memory of Friends (Prayer)
body:
The gods of community see your friends in need and helps them to regain their senses.

Prerequisites: Worshiping a deity with the Community Domain

Benefit: When an ally within 30 ft fails a saving throw since your last action against a spell or spell-like ability from the enchantment school, you can call out to them on your turn and help them regain their senses, giving them another saving throw at your full save bonus.

You may use this ability once per day.
